intro.title: Dynamics
intro.text: Dynamics say how loud: p (piano) soft, mp medium soft, mf medium loud, f (forte) loud. “cresc.” means get gradually louder, “dim.” gradually softer.

intro.title: Not scored
intro.text: The app can't judge loudness yet, so dynamics don't change your score. Tap Listen to hear the shape, then copy it.
